newsitem.title: USA: 21 companies bid for U.S. Stockpile aluminum.
newsitem.headline: 21 companies bid for U.S. Stockpile aluminum.

text.p: Twenty-one companies presented bids for surplus aluminum from the U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center.
Dealers said Glencore was expected to win the lion's share of the 10,000 short tons on offer.

The bidders were VAW, Tenneco Packaging, J Pollock, Alcan, Reynolds Metals, Rochester Aluminum Smelter, Pechiney World Trade, Alumax Materials, Hunter Douglas, Glencore, MG Metal & Commodity, Global Minerals and Metals, Sumitomo Corp, Mitsui, Metal Exchange, Commercial Alloys, Billiton Stratcor, Gerald Metals, Wise Metals, and Trans-World.
The prices offered ranged from a low of $1,250 a short ton from J Pollock to a high of $1,502 from Commercial Alloys, both companies bidding for small lots.
